concept: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties
question: Which of the following elements does NOT belong to group 1 of the modern periodic table?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Radium**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Elements of Group 1 are called **Alkali** metals.
 
• Alkali metal is a part of s block elements.
 
• Being metal they all exhibit electropositive character.
 
• By losing their 1 valence electron they show a valency of +1.
 
• Members of this family include **Hydrogen, Lithium, Sodium, Potassium, Rubidium, Cesium, and Francium**.
 
• **Sodium** and **Potassium **are soft metals whereas Francium is radioactive.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5cd51e9572830dbb04f2625a02821286a64b5bc0d5e8cbe232cf0866c20c3e1.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hydrogen** is the only non-metal present in Group 1 of the Modern Periodic Table.
 
• The vertical columns in the periodic table are called a **group** and the horizontal row is called a **period**.
 
• There are **18 Groups** and **7 periods** in the modern periodic table.
